newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC hits new high on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: CITIC hits new high on overseas demand.

text.p: Shares of conglomerate CITIC Pacific Ltd rose HK$1.70 or 4.03 percent to an all-time high of HK$43.90 in mid-afternoon trade on Friday on strong overseas buying, brokers said.
"Overseas demand was seen hot for CITIC due to its red-chip concept and blue-chip status in otherwise quiet trade," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
Volume was 2.67 million shares worth HK$115.52 million.
Brokers said anticipation of a possible easing in interest rates in China in 1997 also underpined demand for China-related stocks.
Shares of Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd, the second most actively traded stock by turnover after CITIC, surged HK$1.40 to an all-time high of HK$27.20.
China Resources Enterprise Ltd rose HK$0.60 to HK$15.10 and Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd gained HK$0.225 to HK$3.475 in afternoon trade.
